objective: REAL USER SIGNUP - Complete end-to-end authentication vertical slice

work_items.title: Implement signup API endpoint
work_items.user_job: User can create an account via signup form
acceptance: Returns 201 on success with user data
work_items.evidence: apps/web/app/api/auth/signup/route.ts - uses capabilityRegistry to register user, create tenant, workspace, membership

work_items.title: Implement login API endpoint
work_items.user_job: User can login to their account
work_items.evidence: apps/web/app/api/auth/login/route.ts - validates credentials, sets WORKSPACE_SESSION_COOKIE with secure flags

work_items.title: Implement logout API endpoint
work_items.user_job: User can logout of their session
work_items.evidence: apps/web/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts - expires cookie, sets anonymous session

work_items.title: Create signup experience component
work_items.user_job: User sees and can submit signup form
work_items.evidence: apps/web/app/signup/page.tsx - client-side form, fetch to /api/auth/signup, navigation to workspace

work_items.title: Create login experience component
work_items.user_job: User sees and can submit login form
work_items.evidence: apps/web/app/login/page.tsx - client-side form, handles invalid credentials, includes seeded test accounts

work_items.title: Create workspace entry panel
work_items.user_job: Authenticated user lands on their workspace
acceptance: Shows user profile and tenant info
work_items.evidence: Uses @repo/presentation-widgets ProfileHeader, session middleware verifies authentication on every request

work_items.title: Implement session/cookie management
work_items.user_job: User session remains valid across page loads
acceptance: Session lookup works on every request
work_items.evidence: lib/workspace-session.ts implements encode/decode, WORKSPACE_SESSION_COOKIE set with HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite, logout invalidates session

work_items.title: Enforce tenant isolation
work_items.user_job: User can only access their tenant's data
acceptance: Tenant context attached to authenticated user
Cross-tenant access blocked at API route level
work_items.evidence: /apps/web/app/api/tenant/route.ts - filters memberships to only current user, only returns workspaces user is member of, cross-tenant access blocked

work_items.title: E2E signup flow test
work_items.user_job: Complete signup workflow works from browser
work_items.evidence: tests/auth-e2e.test.ts has 12+ passing tests covering full signup→session→logout flow

work_items.title: E2E login/logout/refresh tests
work_items.evidence: E2E tests verify full roundtrip: signup→session check→logout→anonymous, login→session→logout, wrong password blocked

dashboard.next_highest_leverage: Run E2E verification and independent replay to mark BATTLE-1A as REPLAYED, then SHIPPED

E2E tests di apps/web/tests/auth-e2e.test.ts sudah passing semua
